description: Description Using PBIVizEdit SPC Variable Chart (Pro) you can create: Xbar-R chart for monitoring process mean and range. Xbar-S chart for monitoring process mean and standard deviation. I-MR (XMR) chart for individual values and moving range. Subgroup-based charts for batch process analysis. Features available Monitor continuous data using Xbar-R, Xbar-S, and I-MR (XMR) charts. Detect process variation and instability across subgroups and individuals. Built-in mean, standard deviation, and control limits (UCL/LCL). Analyze process average and variation in a single view. Flexible control limits with custom constraints and aggregation. Highlight rule-based violations (trends, runs, above/below mean). Fully customizable axes, labels, legends, and markers.
